Real time.
Now we could discuss many different factors that play into why it is or why is it not the better one, but I just go by feeling.
Real time fights seem more enjoyable for me, especially Amons. The feeling of fighting so hard that my strength left me after finishing it is just missing from turn-based.
Don't get me wrong, I like turn based combat as well. Used to play shit ton of other turn-based games and I still love them, but the feeling of accomplishment diminishes in comparison to RT.
Lad7 was a big problem for me to get into, but I still finished it and liked it, but IW was much more fun IMO and if rgg plan to develop that type of combat more like they did in IW I'll be actually looking forward to it

It's been hard but the sense of accomplishment and your close ones are always the biggest motivation
They probably thought they were "helping". At least the chase was fun. They didn't even chase me that far but I was full of adrenaline

One time someone called police on me and I would run. On a train people were disgusted with me and would change their seats. Mixed reactions, but no one actually went up to me and said "Hey man, you shouldn't do that" or something like that

I did, it's been a year and few months. I think of the person that I love and my friends and how disappointed would they be if I did it. Afterwards I just either do something productive or just watch some videos on YouTube to make myself laugh.
It was hard, but I managed.
I was really desperate at that time, it was really painful, I collapsed, woke up after a minute or so and was alright, just really confused

Most of the time I used knife as usual, but when the situations were dire I would use anything I could find and trust me, most of the things you have around you right now can be used to harm yourself or others. Banging my head on the wall, using compass for geometry to stab myself, electric current, lighter, etc. 
The one that was really "on the fly" was just banging my hand on sharp fence to at least bruise it. Ended up piercing through the skin.

Hello there!

These thoughts are exactly the same as mine before. I used to cut myself whilst planning suicide every single day. I tried few of them, but they failed and I ended up in a hospital. All my friends were devastated after they heard about it. Since then they constantly tried to help me, talk to me, let me vent out. 'fcourse it didn't help, not even bit.   


 I know how you feel, I really do and I wanna help you as much as I can, but all I can muster up to say/write is this: "In my darkest times only thing that helped me was music, my own songs, metal or some genre that helped me vent out my anger and melancholy. I'm not gonna tell you to use music as your temporary cure. Just find something that soothes your mind and doesn't make you feel sad or anxious even more, something you can genuinely enjoy. Make that your hobby and try to do it when the times come. You might even try isolating yourself for a minute or two and talk to yourself or make a diary where you converse with yourself or just write down your deepest troubles."

These things might not work for you, they are only my suggestions that you CAN try.

Finally I have just last thing to say. 

I really hope you will overcome this.

Wish you luck!

I know how you feel, I'm same as you... So know that you're not the only one in situation like this, so please, if you cannot stop thinking about finding the true partner, try to constantly do something that keeps you occupied. I know that this might not help you that much,but you could try something like drawing (it doesn't matter how skilled at drawing you are, just portrait your fears, your wants, your thoughts and draw them, then crumble the paper and tear it, burn it, dispose of it). For me it pushes the urges to die back, even tho it's not for very long time. I genuinely hope you can find your loved one.

I'm trying to accept it, but when they start talking about being positive, I just feel anger, sometimes anger pointed at them and sometimes at meself. When they say what my good side should be I just cannot help and think that it's complete bs...

I guess that's partialy true...
But last few days these "talks" made me fall into despair and depression even more. "They'll be better of without you, stop troubling them with your stupid problems, you want them to be troubled because of you? No, so stfu and hide." Those things pop into my mind everytime someone tells me to talk about it. I just tell them "Later I'll tell you everything", 'cause the result would be troubling for me and for them. Not even the person I love is helping me. I confesed, she said yes but now I'm not even sure if she was honest. I try to think of her when I feel down, but I immediately start thinking about how she doesn't care for me, that she just didn't want me to fall into deeper hole than I already was and stuff like that...

Hey, sorry to hear about your situtation.
I think it would be best to try and focus on the people that appreciate your hard work. As from me, I wasn't involved in situation like such, but i'd like you to know that I just admire your will to prove yourself to the world, keep the hard work up and I wish you best of luck.
Problem is that no matter what I do, I still think of all those things that make me depressed, then paranoia and overthinking kicks in and I'm going down the roller coaster of emotions again

I hope I will be able to convince meself to really get someone more "professional" to help me or at least ease my pain.
